$comment: Every skill under .agents/skills, where it came from, and what it hashed to when vendored. `bun run skills:check` fails when a vendored skill and this file disagree; `tooling/test/skills.test.ts` runs the same check in `bun run test`. Written rather than generated so a reviewer sees the provenance in the diff.

impeccable.why: The design method the prototype phase drives. Vendored rather than installed so a fresh clone has it offline, which is the whole argument of shipping the method with the code.

brand-review.why: marketing-skills. Go-to-market work in the discover and ship phases.

product-development.why: The four-phase method as a skill: discover, prototype, build, ship.

better-auth.why: Which checks belong to better-auth and which to our policies. The traps here are the most expensive in the repository.

effect-sql-rls.why: withOrgScope, the two database roles, and the shape a policy has to take. Tenancy is the one guarantee a wrong edit breaks silently.

tanstack-start-ssr.why: The SSR boundary and the three hydration traps that each shipped once.

effect-form-e2e.why: Forms bound to contract field schemas, and the browser harness's rules.
